rule: The last two of five measured xy points at 10 Hz define an unscaled constant velocity. Minimize mean Euclidean distance to its 30-step extrapolation; exact ties choose higher network probability then lower index. Each method scores the mean error and step-30 error of its one path.
oracle_definition: Future-informed reference: select the candidate with minimum true ADE (lowest index on ties); FDE is for that same candidate. The direct velocity path is unrestricted.
development_scope: Exploratory choice informed by earlier CV and candidate-coverage results on these same four sites. All 40 fits frozen. Each site averages its own windows, then sites and the five seeds receive equal weight. New-site performance has not been measured.

interval.method: Average paired reranked-minus-network errors over the same five seeds per window, then jointly resample whole clips within each site. Four-site means give equal weight to sites. Percentile intervals conditional on these sites and fits.
